name: Grand Châtelet
text: The Grand Châtelet was a fortress in Ancien Régime Paris, on the right bank of the Seine, on the site of what is now the Place du Châtelet; it contained a court and police headquarters and a number of prisons.

depictions.name: Grand Chatelet
depictions.text: The Grand Châtelet was a fortress in Paris, France, later used as a prison.
